title: Conversation Lifecycle, Transparent Tool Telemetry, and Resilient History Management

context.problem: The Antigravity Companion app currently exhibits three critical reliability, observability, and accessibility flaws: (1) Cold-start state desynchronization where the UI boots into a blank chat screen while the underlying adapter and server quietly retain and attach new prompts to the previous active conversation; (2) Opaque execution failure modes where interrupted, stalled, or tool-centric turns hide executed tools, terminal statuses, and intermediate steps—rendering blank messages or generic 'لا يوجد رد'; and (3) An inaccessible, fragmented conversation drawer where title, metadata, and resume triggers are split across separate DOM elements without primitives to rename, pin, or delete conversations.
constraints: Android Termux Resource Bounds: Companion server memory ceiling strictly < 80 MB, single-threaded async event loop

Accessibility Invariants: WCAG 2.2 AAA compliance for TalkBack and Jieshuo (CSR). Unified focus targets, zero emoji noise in speech, explicit aria-live announcements for conversation switches and actions
Authoritative Transcript Immutability: CLI logs in ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/brain/ are append-only. Custom titles and pinning must not corrupt raw transcript files
Zero Stealth Sessions: The UI chat feed and backend runtime must always agree on the active conversation ID. Cold start must visibly rehydrate or explicitly isolate a new session
Regression Safety: Existing unit and end-to-end suites (run_tests.py, run_main_ui_tests.cjs, run_backend_tests.py) must maintain 100% pass rate

functional.text: Deterministic Cold-Start & Visible Hydration: On launch, if an active conversation is tracked, the UI must automatically fetch and visibly render all historical messages, tool cards, and title in the chat feed, vocalizing the loaded session via aria-live. If the user initiates a new chat, the backend session must be explicitly severed to guarantee zero context leakage.

Transparent Tool Telemetry & Terminal Failure Reporting: Legacy transcript parsing and live streaming must extract complete tool call metadata (tool name, arguments summary, execution status, and preview output). Turns ending without text (due to crash, timeout, or tool completion) must render structured accessible Tool Cards and an explicit terminal status banner instead of 'لا يوجد رد'.

Unified Accessible Conversation List Item: Replace fragmented card elements with a single cohesive interactive button (single-tap resume) that opens the conversation and closes the drawer with a single screen reader focus target.

Contextual Conversation Options (Rename, Pin, Delete): Beside each conversation card, provide an accessible Options Menu button exposing: (a) Rename (prompt dialog saving custom title), (b) Pin/Unpin (toggles sticky top placement), and (c) Delete (confirmation modal permanently deleting brain folder and cache).

Persistent Metadata Ledger: Maintain a lightweight JSON metadata ledger on the server and IndexedDB cache to store custom titles, pin timestamps, and soft-deleted records without touching read-only CLI transcript files.

nonFunctional.text: Accessibility & Screen Reader Navigation: Zero redundant focus stops in conversation items; context menus use native dialog / ARIA menu patterns with keyboard Esc support.
Hydration Latency: Cold-start conversation rehydration must complete within < 150 ms on Android Termux for transcripts under 100 turns.
Memory Footprint: Metadata ledger and expanded tool models must add less than 2.5 MB to server RSS memory.

excluded: Full-text fuzzy search across all historical transcripts (reserved for future desktop indexing)
Multi-user conversation sharing or cloud synchronization
assumptions: Antigravity CLI transcript files (~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/brain/{cid}/.system_generated/logs/transcript.jsonl) follow standard JSONL schema with PLANNER_RESPONSE and USER_INPUT types.
Companion WebUI is hosted either inside Android WebView or mobile Chromium browser on localhost:7681.

entities.name: ConversationMetadata
entities.description: User-defined attributes (custom title, pinned state, deletion flag, last accessed timestamp) mapped to conversation_id.

entities.name: HydratedTurn
entities.description: Unified turn model representing user request, internal thinking, tool execution list (name, arguments, status, output preview), and final textual response or terminal failure state.

entities.name: ToolExecutionRecord
entities.description: Detailed trace of an individual tool call within a turn (tool name, short params summary, execution duration, output preview, and exit status).

invariants: UI Active State Invariant: The UI must never display a blank conversation while silently sending prompts to an existing conversation ID.
Visual-Auditory Parity Invariant: Every message and tool card rendered visually must have a corresponding concise, screen-reader friendly accessible description.
Safe Deletion Invariant: Deleting a conversation must close active sessions for that ID before unlinking the brain storage directory.

deepDives.title: Cold-Start Determinism & Session Race Prevention
deepDives.pressure: Prevent user prompts from accidentally polluting past conversations when opening the app.
deepDives.decision: On startup, main-ui.js calls GET /api/v1/conversations/active. If an active conversation exists and was not explicitly closed, it calls resumeConversation() to visibly populate messages and announce the title. If no active conversation exists, it explicitly sets currentActiveConversationId = null and forces a fresh session handshake on the first prompt.
rejectedAlternatives: Silent background attachment: Kept existing bug where UI looked new but posted to old chat.
Always forcing a new conversation on startup: Disrupts user workflow when returning to an in-progress coding session.
deepDives.failureMode: Network error or slow disk on boot: UI falls back to showing an explicit 'استئناف آخر محادثة' banner with the title rather than silently binding.

deepDives.title: Full Tool Telemetry Hydration from JSONL Transcripts
deepDives.pressure: Display what the agent actually did when a conversation stalls or fails during tool execution.
deepDives.decision: Enhance LegacyConversations.transcript() to correlate PLANNER_RESPONSE tool_calls with subsequent USER_INPUT tool results. Extract tool name, parameters, and output previews into a structured tools list for each turn. If content is empty and tools exist, mark status as completed_tools or interrupted_in_tools and render accessible Tool Result Accordions.
rejectedAlternatives: Only showing integer tool_count: Left user blind to which tools were run and why no text was generated.
Full unparsed JSON dump: Crashed mobile WebView due to multi-megabyte string payloads.
deepDives.failureMode: Malformed tool call JSON in transcript: Safely fall back to displaying tool name and raw snippet with non-fatal logging.

deepDives.title: Accessible Conversation Drawer Item & Actions Menu
deepDives.pressure: Screen reader clutter and lack of management primitives (rename, pin, delete).
deepDives.decision: Implement a unified 2-target layout per list item: Target 1 is the full card button (<button class='btn-conv-main'>) that resumes the chat on tap. Target 2 is a dedicated Options Menu button (<button class='btn-conv-options'>) opening an accessible popup dialog with 3 explicit action buttons: 'إعادة تسمية', 'تثبيت/إلغاء التثبيت', and 'حذف المحادثة'.
rejectedAlternatives: Keeping separate title text and resume button: Caused multiple confusing tab stops on TalkBack/Jieshuo.
Swipe-to-delete gestures: Incompatible with screen reader touch exploration.
deepDives.failureMode: Accidental deletion: Protected by an accessible modal confirmation dialog with auto-focus on 'إلغاء'.

architectures.name: Unified Metadata Ledger & Deep Turn Telemetry (Recommended)
architectures.thesis: Introduce a server-side JSON metadata ledger for user overrides (pinning, custom titles, soft deletion) while enhancing legacy transcript parsing to emit rich tool cards, married to a streamlined two-button accessible conversation list item.

tradeoffs.complexity: Low-to-medium. Extends existing server and WebUI architecture without adding binary dependencies or databases.
tradeoffs.durability: High. Metadata is preserved across browser cache flushes on the server disk.
tradeoffs.a11y: Exceptional. Every action is exposed via semantic buttons and native dialog modals.

architectures.name: Client-Only IndexedDB Overlay
architectures.thesis: Perform all renaming, pinning, and tool synthesis purely inside the browser's IndexedDB and JavaScript adapter without modifying the server or Python parsers.

components.note: Parses tool strings on client and stores pins in IndexedDB

tradeoffs.complexity: Low on backend, but high client-side DOM parsing burden.
tradeoffs.durability: Fragile. Any WebView cache clear or private browsing session wipes all custom titles and pins.
tradeoffs.deletion: Incomplete. Client cannot delete server brain directories.

architectures.name: Full SQLite IPC & Database Engine
architectures.thesis: Migrate all conversation tracking, transcripts, and metadata into a centralized SQLite database in WAL mode on Termux.

components.name: conversations.db (WAL)
components.note: Relational store for messages, tools, and pins

tradeoffs.complexity: High. Requires schema migrations, dual-write syncing with CLI JSONL logs, and lock management on Termux.
tradeoffs.performance: Potential database lock bottlenecks under concurrent subagent runs.

comparison.rationale: Architecture 1 provides the exact balance of durability and low operational overhead required for Android Termux. It introduces an atomic server-side JSON metadata ledger without introducing heavy relational database engines, fully preserves CLI raw logs while hydrating tool execution cards, and provides zero-stealth startup synchronisation with an accessible two-target conversation drawer item.

findings.description: main-v1-adapter.js maintains session state in sessionStorage independently from main-ui.js active conversation tracking, allowing the UI to present a blank chat while the adapter routes prompts into a previous conversation.
legacy_conversations.py transcript() discards tool_calls names and outputs, condensing them into an opaque integer tool_count, leaving resumed and failed runs completely unobservable.
conv-card-item in main-ui.js splits the conversation title and resume button into separate elements, forcing screen readers through redundant non-interactive text nodes before reaching the action.
No mutation endpoints exist for conversations: users cannot rename, pin, or delete conversation archives.

risks.risk: Accidental deletion of active conversation directory
risks.mitigation: Before unlinking brain folder, server verifies if session is active; if active, it gracefully terminates the session and unregisters the process.

risks.risk: Large transcripts with 100+ tool calls slowing down drawer resume
risks.mitigation: Hydration bounds tool previews to 25 items and clamps string previews to 500 characters per tool.

nextSteps: Step 1: Implement server/conversation_metadata.py and integrate with server/application.py (PATCH / DELETE / GET).
Step 2: Upgrade LegacyConversations.transcript() to hydrate tool_calls into structured message tools array.
Step 3: Update main-v1-adapter.js to handle deterministic cold-start hydration and conversation mutation API calls.
Step 4: Refactor conversations drawer in main-ui.js and main-ui.css to render unified card buttons with adjacent accessible 3-action options menu.
Step 5: Run full test verification suites (run_backend_tests.py, run_ui_tests.cjs, run_tests.py) to achieve 100% pass.

adr.title: ADR-002: Deterministic Session Startup, First-Class Tool Telemetry, and Accessible Conversation Management
adr.context: Companion users suffered from silent session pollution on startup, lack of visibility into agent tool executions upon resuming failed runs, and a disjointed conversation drawer lacking rename, pin, and delete actions.
adr.decision: Adopt Architecture 1: Implement a server-side JSON metadata ledger, parse full tool calls in transcript hydration, enforce explicit cold-start synchronization, and introduce unified two-target accessible conversation cards with dedicated options menus.

positive: Eliminates silent prompt pollution into old conversations
Provides 100% transparent visibility into executed tools and terminal failure states
Enables renaming, pinning to top, and safe deletion of conversations
Significantly improves TalkBack and Jieshuo navigation with unified cards and ARIA dialogs
negative: Adds one JSON metadata ledger file to the server data directory
Requires syncing client IndexedDB cache on mutation operations
